The '''2015–16 Danish Superliga''' season was the 26th season of the [[Denmark|Danish]] [[Danish Superliga|Superliga]], which decides the [[Danish football championship]]. [[FC Midtjylland|Midtjylland]] were the defending champions.

As Denmark dropped from nineteenth to twenty-second place in the 2015 UEFA association coefficient rankings at the end of the 2014–15 season, the champion of the league will qualify for the UEFA Champions League; that club will commence its campaign in the second qualifying round. Furthermore, the second and third-place clubs will enter the UEFA Europa League in the first qualifying round.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://kassiesa.net/uefa/data/method4/crank2015.html | title=UEFA Country Ranking 2015 }}</ref>

Only one team was relegated after the season due to the Superliga expanding to 14 teams from the beginning of the 2016–17 season.<ref>{{cite web |title=Superligaen udvides til 14 hold |url=http://www.b.dk/sport/superligaen-udvides-til-14-hold |publisher=[[Berlingske Tidende]] |date=2015-06-20 |last=Sejersbøl |first=Morten Crone |access-date=2015-06-20 |language=da }}</ref>

==Teams==
[[FC Vestsjælland]] and [[Silkeborg IF]] finished the [[2014–15 Danish Superliga|2014–15 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2015–16 Danish 1st Division|2015–16 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2014–15 Danish 1st Division|2014–15 1st Division]] champions [[Viborg FF]] and the runners-up [[Aarhus Gymnastikforening|AGF]].

A new sponsorship agreement for [[Randers Stadium]] was presented on 22 September 2015, when the Fårup-based fertilizer company BioNutria acquired the naming rights for the stadium from AutoC, effectively changing the name of the home field of Randers FC from AutoC Park Randers to BioNutria Park Randers.<ref name="tipsbladet.dk-randers-fc-hjemmebane-bliver-bionutria-park">{{cite web|last1=Ehrhorn |first1=Michael |title=Randers FC-hjemmebane bliver BioNutria Park |url=http://www.tipsbladet.dk/nyhed/superliga/randers-fc-hjemmebane-bliver-bionutria-park |website=tipsbladet.dk |publisher=[[Tipsbladet]] |access-date=20 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170520193654/http://www.tipsbladet.dk/nyhed/superliga/randers-fc-hjemmebane-bliver-bionutria-park |archive-date=20 May 2017 |language=da |date=22 September 2015 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Last in the season, the stadium of [[FC Nordsjælland]] changed its official name to Right to Dream Park following a naming rights agreement with the young academy Right to Dream, taking effect on 27 April 2016.<ref name="bold.dk-farum-right-to-dream-park">{{cite web|last1=Anker-Møller |first1=Kristian |title=Farum Park bliver til Right to Dream Park |url=http://www.bold.dk/fodbold/nyheder/farum-park-bliver-til-right-to-dream-park/ |publisher=bold.dk |access-date=20 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170520194335/http://www.bold.dk/fodbold/nyheder/farum-park-bliver-til-right-to-dream-park/ |archive-date=20 May 2017 |language=da |date=27 April 2016 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
